variants.name: 01-natural
variants.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create one game-art prototype by editing the attached mining-game screenshot. Preserve its orthographic 2D view, brown rocky tile background, approximate ore deposit region and game-art scale. No text, no UI, no borders. Replace the loose orange crystal heaps with ore visibly embedded in rock; uneven stone lips occlude the minerals, no floating piles or uniform circular clusters. Retain sparse dark coal deposits on the left but embed them too. Match the existing painterly faceted game art; do not turn into a photograph. Variant 1: natural mineral inclusions. Muted burnt-orange and copper-red angular mineral flecks, tiny to medium fragments, scattered through irregular narrow fissures with occasional richer patches. Very little protrusion, non-emissive mineral facets with small restrained highlights. Subtle host-rock discoloration. Readable deposits but most of the image remains brown rock.
